name: Aquiplex
shortDescription: Aquiplex builds Aqua, a personal thinking system designed to understand a person's digital world and become more useful over time.
description: Aquiplex builds Aqua, a personal thinking system that understands the user's digital world and uses that understanding to provide increasingly useful assistance over time.
vision: Build the world's most context-aware AI.
mission: Create AI that truly understands your digital world.

coreValues.name: Accuracy over confidence
coreValues.detail: Aqua never invents facts. When it is unsure, it says so.

coreValues.name: One coherent system
coreValues.detail: One AI for the whole platform, not a bolt-on chatbot per feature.

coreValues.name: Show your work
coreValues.detail: Edits arrive as previewable, verifiable patches; reasoning and provider choices are transparent.

coreValues.name: Resilience by design
coreValues.detail: Provider-agnostic routing with self-healing fallback — no single model or vendor is a single point of failure.

coreValues.name: Understanding that compounds
coreValues.detail: Aqua should use accumulated, accurate understanding so future assistance becomes more relevant instead of merely accumulating raw memories.

_meta.note: The product thesis and core capability are defined in assistant.json so Aqua can distinguish company vision from product identity and implementation status.
